messages:
incident-bot: AUTOMATIC PAGE fired: gpu-memory-pressure on pool infer-west2a (nvml OOM-like signals). severity=high, affected-pools=[infer-west2a], auto-evac=false. link: https://internal.monitoring/alert/4421112222

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-78421 created and routed to oncall-maya. Escalation policy: gpu-oncall-primary. URL: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-78421

maya: acked. investigating now. pulling traces + recent deploys.

maya: quick check: Grafana shows memory usage spike on nodes gpu-west2a-03/04 starting 02:11:12 UTC, vram % -> 98%. ks: heavy kvcache churn.

ops-sre: @maya can you confirm if fallback routing is triggered? I see increased 503s from the inference proxy.

maya: seeing ~6% of requests getting 5xx, top customer logs show CUDA alloc failure: `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` and `nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo` high. Looks like KV cache + long seq jobs.

emily-cs: FYI customer-flagged: account acme-inc seeing elevated errors on embeddings; CS on it and prepping a status note.

alex: joining. suggest quick mitigation: 1) cordon the two hottest nodes 2) scale up fallback pool + reroute low-priority traffic 3) trigger kvcache purge on affected model shims.

maya: concur. planning to cordon g-west2a-03 and g-west2a-04, then drain non-critical workloads. executing now:

maya: ```bash
kubectl cordon g-west2a-03 -n inference
kubectl drain g-west2a-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference --grace-period=60
kubectl cordon g-west2a-04 -n inference
kubectl drain g-west2a-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference --grace-period=60
```

ops-sre: while cording, enable fallback routing: `/svc/infer/proxy/route?policy=fallback-high` (internal). I'll flip it.

ops-sre: flipped fallback routing to include cpu-fallback pool; monitoring for latency impact.

maya: cordon/drain commands returned: g-west2a-03 drain succeeded, g-west2a-04 drain in progress (pod stuck: model-shim-rtx pinned to node, trying eviction).

alex: if model-shim is stuck, send kill + restart for that pod. `kubectl delete pod model-shim-rtx-7f9d -n inference` then it should reschedule to healthy node.

maya: deleted stuck pod, rescheduled to gpu-burst-01 (dedicated). memory usage on remaining nodes now trending down to ~70%.

pagerduty-bot: INC-78421 acknowledged by maya at 02:14:48 UTC.

emily-cs: passing note to acme-inc: "We're seeing a GPU memory pressure event affecting a subset of inference requests. We have mitigations in place and are routing traffic to fallback pools. Expect intermittent 5xx for ~10-20 minutes. Will update." :thumbsup:

maya: traffic error rate dropped from 6% -> 1.2% after reroute + drains. latency increased ~50ms on fallback, acceptable.

ops-sre: confirmed no new nvml OOMs after drains. KCACHE evictions decreased, looks stable.

maya: preparing handoff to alex for full remediation + postmortem. summary: root cause suspected kvcache fragmentation + one long-running batch job causing transient OOM chain; immediate mitigation: cordon+drain two nodes, enable fallback routing, evict stuck shim, purge kvcache heuristics.

alex: taking over. I'll run a targeted kvcache compaction and add a temporary autoscaler rule to avoid single-node hotshots. Also will open a postmortem ticket and assign action items.

alex: assigning follow-ups: ACTION-1: add soft memory cap to model-shim (PR #1234), ACTION-2: tune kvcache compaction thresholds (PR #1235), ACTION-3: improve alerts to include eviction rate context (ACTION-3 ticket created).

maya: handoff complete. I'm un-acking PD so it can route if new pages happen during the window.

pagerduty-bot: INC-78421 reassigned to alex at 02:35:80 UTC.

incident-bot: NOTE: no active pages for infer-west2a for 10m; monitor for 30m before close.

emily-cs: please ping me when you have a postmortem summary so I can draft customer communication.

alex: will do, I'll post the postmortem link in #incidents and tag CS.

maya: thanks all. closing thread here unless new alerts appear. :white_check_mark:
